name: q3_migration_20261028
problem_statement_note: 缺陷化合物以所列 DMS/Diacetyl/4VG/trans-2-nonenal/Stale hops 等超阈值项为准
lambda_selection: largest lambda whose projected spectrum is still nearest to the target-style centroid; fallback = smallest target-centroid distance

criteria.A: set form of the problem note: the set of over-threshold defects does not expand and the severity of each over-threshold defect does not increase
criteria.B: per-defect severity e_after <= e_before with e(c, T) = max(c / T - 1, 0)
criteria.C: aggregated severity sum_d e_after <= sum_d e_before

defect_projection.missing_source: cap = min(target-style median, 0.9 * threshold), flagged conditional
defect_projection.note: 0.9 x threshold headroom is a modelling choice, not a measured safety limit

style_identifiability_expected: tasting_category_fine is weakly separable in the supplied coordinates; accuracy is reported, not used as a hard gate
honesty: A migrated spectrum is a statistical destination inside the supplied coordinate space, not a brewing recipe and not a measured beer; the projection certifies only the listed defect coordinates at the 0.9 x threshold headroom and does not certify physical brewability or sensory acceptance.
